name: South Carolina

statute.name: South Carolina Freedom of Information Act
statute.citation: S.C. Code Ann. §§ 30-4-10 et seq. (RCFP cites §§ 30-4-20, -30, -40, -100, -110; full chapter range not stated)

response.rule_text: For records under 24 months old, notify requester of determination within 10 days excluding weekends and holidays; 20 days for older records; records then furnished within 30 days (35 for older) (§ 30-4-30(c)). Missed deadline means the request is considered approved (§ 30-4-30, 30-4-15).

fees.labor_rule: Search, retrieval and redaction capped at prorated hourly salary of lowest-paid employee with necessary skill; no fee for review to determine disclosability.
fees.copy_rule: Actual cost of copies; no copy charge for electronic transmission.
fees.waiver_rule: Body may waive or reduce fees if furnishing primarily benefits the general public.
fees.late_penalty: Court may award damages or injunction and fine the body $500 for arbitrary and capricious refusal or delay (§ 30-4-110).

residency.rule_text: Any person has a right to inspect or copy public records (§ 30-4-30); but suit under § 30-4-100 is for 'any citizen of the State' and RCFP says it is open whether a non-resident U.S. citizen may sue.

appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal; sue in Court of Common Pleas within one year of the violation (§ 30-4-100), initial hearing within ten days of service, attorney fees to prevailing requester.

format_rule: Right to inspect, copy, or receive electronic transmission (§ 30-4-30(A)(1)); no duty to create an electronic version (§ 30-4-30(A)(2)); form convenient and practical for requester.
notes: Read chars 0-200k. Silence leads to deemed APPROVAL, though exemptions can still be asserted (Litchfield Plantation 1994); RCFP also says delay is treated as denial for appeal. Deadlines extendable by written agreement. 365 days for suit is 'one year' converted. Legislature covered except members' memoranda/correspondence (§ 30-4-40(a)(8)). Universities: only research/endowment exemptions mentioned. Wait for deposit (max 25%) delays clock.
